title: Lag-1 draw-range state memory
hypothesis: The previous draw's range (maximum minus minimum) may add one-step information about the next draw's range beyond the exact combinatorial marginal distribution.

models.M1: One-step categorical shrinkage conditional on previous range s: p_t(r|s) = [alpha*q0(r) + N_{s,r}(t)] / [alpha + N_s(t)].

walk_forward.chronological_splits: 60% discovery / 20% validation / remaining 20% historical blind OOS; floor for first two segments.
walk_forward.cutoff_rule: Only transition pairs (R_i,R_{i+1}) with i+1 <= t-1 are eligible for target t; history cutoff is the previous draw date.
walk_forward.inference: Historical blind OOS only; discovery and validation descriptive because no tuning is performed.

primary: M0 minus M1 multiclass Brier loss (positive favors M1)
M0 minus M1 multiclass log-loss (positive favors M1)
endpoints.null: M0 exact marginal; also report M1 against M0.
endpoints.multiple_testing: Holm step-down across the two preregistered blind-OOS endpoints.

guardrails: No target or future draw is used in forecast construction.
Forecast is computed before the target outcome is scored.
Historical blind OOS is not a virgin holdout; prior SONAR work examined related structural features.
No production scorer, canonical archive, Q60 gate, H101/H102 freeze, or existing forecast is modified.
No merge or engine promotion; human review required.
